claim_ceiling: Finite synthetic conformance cases only; no production directory, protocol conformance, Holochain runtime, anti-Sybil, or performance claim.

scenarios.title: Exact active realm membership and complete permission tuple
scenarios.premise: Realm membership, issuer and policy are current; one binding covers this exact subject, resource, action, audience and purpose.
scenarios.requested_operation: Read resource R in realm A
scenarios.expected_enforcement: Allow only this exact request and policy epoch.
scenarios.invariant: No single-field or partial-tuple inference is permitted.

scenarios.title: Valid DID but no membership in the target realm
scenarios.premise: The subject controls a valid DID but has no accepted membership statement in realm A.
scenarios.requested_operation: Read resource R in realm A
scenarios.expected_enforcement: Reject; identity evidence does not create membership.
scenarios.invariant: DID control is not organizational membership.

scenarios.title: Credential signature valid under an issuer key that the realm has not admitted
scenarios.premise: Cryptographic signature verifies, but issuer/key admission is absent or unknown under realm policy.
scenarios.requested_operation: Use credential to obtain realm role
scenarios.expected_enforcement: Reject the credential as an authority input.
scenarios.invariant: Signature validity is distinct from issuer trust/currentness.
scenarios.claim_ceiling: No external issuer is declared trustworthy.

scenarios.title: Subject is a member of realm A but requests access in realm B without a federation contract
scenarios.premise: Realm A membership is valid; realm B has no accepted mapping or trust link.
scenarios.expected_enforcement: Reject cross-realm mapping.
scenarios.invariant: Foreign membership does not become local membership automatically.

scenarios.title: Resource, action and audience are drawn from different independent grants
scenarios.premise: Each individual dimension appears in some valid grant, but no one authority atom covers the whole request tuple.
scenarios.requested_operation: Delete resource R for audience X
scenarios.expected_enforcement: Reject synthetic Cartesian composition.
scenarios.invariant: One coherent authority witness must cover the full request.

scenarios.title: Nested groups contain a cycle
scenarios.premise: The realm's group graph has a detected cycle; no bounded acyclic expansion proof exists.
scenarios.expected_enforcement: Reject the malformed graph and affected expansion.
scenarios.invariant: Cycle detection cannot silently truncate and overgrant.

scenarios.title: Acyclic nested group resolves to an exact role binding
scenarios.premise: Membership is valid; group graph is acyclic; depth and expansion bounds are respected; role binding covers exact request.
scenarios.requested_operation: Read resource R in realm A
scenarios.expected_enforcement: Allow exact request and preserve group-path provenance.
scenarios.invariant: Nested groups may expand only under frozen, bounded semantics.

scenarios.title: A signed revocation exists but the high-risk PEP has only an older cached policy epoch
scenarios.premise: The PEP cannot prove it has integrated the latest authority frontier; a stale cache remains locally available.
scenarios.expected_enforcement: Do not execute; refresh authority or deny after required freshness cannot be established.
scenarios.invariant: Missing currentness is not evidence of continuing authority.

scenarios.title: Partitioned PEP has a valid, unexpired lease for a low-risk read
scenarios.premise: The lease is signed, subject/resource/action/audience scoped, policy-bound and within the low-risk offline age limit.
scenarios.expected_enforcement: Allow only within the declared lease and risk profile; record bounded stale mode.
scenarios.invariant: Offline availability is allowed only within the lease contract.
scenarios.claim_ceiling: This does not authorize privileged writes.

scenarios.title: High-risk PEP is disconnected and its required freshness lease has expired
scenarios.premise: No current authority observation is available and the last high-risk lease is expired.
scenarios.expected_enforcement: Deny effect; reconcile authority before any new mutation.
scenarios.invariant: Expired or unavailable freshness evidence cannot authorize a high-risk action.
scenarios.claim_ceiling: No availability claim beyond the declared lease.

scenarios.title: Issuer key is present in a stale cached directory but currentness cannot be established
scenarios.premise: Cached issuer directory is older than its permitted freshness profile; revalidation is unavailable.
scenarios.expected_enforcement: Do not accept for authority decisions; preserve stale classification.
scenarios.invariant: Key presence in a stale directory is not current admission.

scenarios.title: Old realm administrator key signs after a fresh, effective key-rotation epoch
scenarios.premise: The realm's accepted key frontier excludes the old key; signature is valid cryptographically but signed by a superseded key.
scenarios.expected_enforcement: Reject old-epoch administrative action.
scenarios.invariant: Cryptographic validity does not override key lifecycle/currentness.

scenarios.title: Two required administrator authorities disagree or quorum cannot be established
scenarios.premise: Policy requires distinct threshold approval; signatures are missing, conflicting or correlated under the frozen failure-domain policy.
scenarios.expected_enforcement: Do not commit the policy change; preserve the disagreement evidence.
scenarios.invariant: A partial or correlated quorum is not a valid threshold decision.

scenarios.title: Workload credential is valid but has the wrong trust domain or audience
scenarios.premise: SVID signature and lifetime are valid, but target service/audience or accepted trust domain does not match.
scenarios.expected_enforcement: Reject the request at the receiving service PEP.
scenarios.invariant: Valid workload identity is not valid for every audience or domain.

scenarios.title: Machine ID is copied during clone/reimage and no independent hardware-attestation evidence exists
scenarios.premise: Software-held identity material is duplicated; hardware uniqueness and attestation are unknown.
scenarios.requested_operation: Enroll clone as a distinct trusted endpoint
scenarios.expected_enforcement: Quarantine or require explicit re-enrollment; do not assert physical uniqueness.
scenarios.invariant: A copied identifier cannot prove unique hardware.

scenarios.title: SCIM deprovision event has been accepted, but an older application session remains active
scenarios.premise: The directory object is inactive; a stale refresh token/session still reaches an effect-capable route.
scenarios.expected_enforcement: Invalidate or block the session at the actual PEP; record residual-path exposure.
scenarios.invariant: Deprovisioning must reach active sessions, tokens and background workers.
scenarios.claim_ceiling: SCIM resource state alone is not proof of universal termination.

scenarios.title: Identity and membership are valid but requested resource/action differs from the grant
scenarios.premise: The exact grant permits read on resource R but request is write on resource R or read on resource S.
scenarios.expected_enforcement: Reject exact scope mismatch.
scenarios.invariant: Membership is not blanket resource authority.

scenarios.title: Break-glass access has two distinct approved authorities, justification, narrow scope and short expiry
scenarios.premise: Realm policy permits emergency access; distinct approvers satisfy quorum; request binds one resource/action; expiry and one-shot use are valid.
scenarios.expected_enforcement: Allow exactly once within the approved emergency scope and create an audit/reconciliation obligation.
scenarios.invariant: Emergency authority is bounded and separately evidenced.

scenarios.title: Break-glass request lacks expiry, required approver or reconciliation owner
scenarios.premise: At least one required emergency constraint is absent or unknown.
scenarios.expected_enforcement: Reject; do not create an implicit permanent override.
scenarios.invariant: Emergency mode must not bypass the authority model.

scenarios.title: Presented policy epoch is older than the local monotonic accepted high-water mark
scenarios.premise: The PEP has a trusted persisted high-water mark and detects policy rollback.
scenarios.expected_enforcement: Reject rollback; require explicit recovery ceremony and independent reconciliation.
scenarios.invariant: A previously accepted newer epoch cannot be silently replaced by an older one.
scenarios.claim_ceiling: Rollback control for the stated local persistence model.

scenarios.title: Private staff membership or HR attributes are submitted as public DHT entries or links
scenarios.premise: The disclosure classifier says these fields/relationships are private; attempted publication exposes payload or sensitive relationship metadata.
scenarios.expected_enforcement: Reject publication; use local/private or explicitly encrypted minimal disclosure path.
scenarios.invariant: Privacy policy covers payloads, links, indexes and metadata.

scenarios.title: A verifier-bound credential presentation nonce has already been consumed
scenarios.premise: Presentation signature and holder binding are otherwise valid, but the exact challenge was already consumed or is expired.
scenarios.requested_operation: Reuse presentation for another verifier transaction
scenarios.expected_enforcement: Reject replay and preserve the original transaction binding.
scenarios.invariant: A valid proof is not reusable outside its audience, nonce and expiry.

scenarios.title: Authorization succeeded but the downstream effect outcome is unknown after timeout/crash
scenarios.premise: A signed Allow and dispatch attempt exist; provider acknowledgement/observation is ambiguous.
scenarios.expected_enforcement: Do not issue a new mutation; reconcile the original idempotency key and external state first.
scenarios.invariant: Authorization, dispatch and observed effect are separate states.
